column1: # UnitType remaining batch: owner <TAB> M <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Matrix orientation was pinned by four independent call sites. a(UnitType) is used to ATTACK
# (AttackNearestNode, HasTargetInRange) and b(UnitType) to EVADE (EvadeThreatNode, IsThreatened),
# so a() means the receiver wins the matchup. Bodies: a(o)=b[o][t]-b[t][o]>=200, b(o)=b[t][o]-b[o][t]>=200,
# c(o)=b[o][t]. All three agree on field b[X][Y] = damage dealt BY Y TO X, which makes
# a(o)=my damage to o minus its damage to me (strong against), b(o) its converse (weak against)
# and c(o)=my damage to o. InitAttackPlan uses c() against a >=50 threshold, consistent with
# hundreds-scale matrix values.
# The two (Domain,Layer) rows average the same matrix over that domain/layer: a() averages
# b[other][this] (damage I deal out) and b() averages b[this][other] (damage I take in).
# Behavioural rows, all evidence from WorldSimulator:
#   s()  at line 705: when true the shooter rotates its hull toward the target and may only
#        fire within 45 degrees - tracked vehicles (BattleTank/Artillery/MissileTank).
#   y()  at line 725: unit.d(now + unitType.y()) sets the next-shot timer (Artillery 2.6 > Tank 1.2).
#   z()  static 1000: unit.c(...? 0 : z()) initialises a unit, getHealth() < z() flags a damaged
#        one and GameScreen draws getHealth()*9/z() segments - a health scale.
#   K()  = getCapacity() > 0, guarded everywhere as K() && subUnits < getCapacity() (can carry).
#   N()  true only for Carrier and Airfield in BOTH rulesets - the aircraft platforms.
#   C()  true for every building incl. OilField; WorldSimulator:504 tests C() && B() && owner ==
#        null, i.e. a capturable structure and a capturing unit.
#   D()  true only for Dsf Mechanic; WorldSimulator:1056 looks up a same-domain unit of that type.
#   G()  at line 333 bounds a distance to the guard position; values are tile counts (Artillery 4).
# Left blank on purpose: g() (static 24, only use is /5 in WorldSimulator:772), n() (a render
# dimension factor, not the movement factor doc 17 guessed), r() (FighterPlane-only guard
# exemption), A()/E() (never true in either ruleset) and F() (no call site found).
